evidence_candidates.excerpt: Pawsey describes Setonix as an HPE Cray EX system using AMD EPYC CPUs and Instinct GPUs, integrated with ClusterStor storage, object and tape tiers, upgraded ingest nodes, and a 400 Gbps network backbone for research workflows.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: Public research-computing programs are integrating accelerator compute with data, network and application infrastructure rather than treating compute rank as the sole outcome.
